verified_observations.observation: 2024 meta-analysis: five brief audio mindfulness induction studies, n=277, limited attentional evidence; bias/low certainty.
111 RCTs with n=9538 tested mindfulness training interventions; effects vary across cognition outcomes and comparators.
2023 EEG review on binaural beat entrainment reports inconsistent evidence across 14 studies.
2020 adverse-events review: 83 included studies, 6703 participants; estimates varied substantially across study designs.
2022 review 61 selected studies 8620 participants on negative effects in meditation and mind-body practices.
